author: AdroitDeity
quote: The graphics for this game are very pretty which is why I gave it a 1. However the story itself doesnt feel GTA like, but more like a keeping up with your gf simulator. When GTA V released it puts you right into the chaos with bank robbery, with GTA 6 it opens with house simulator -_-. Also you cant steal your neighbors car or if you find an super nice car you cant keep it. In Grand Theft Auto seems like they left out the Grand Theft Auto aspect. Misandry galore.
